column3: With respect to the 205 East 42nd Street Mortgage Loan (9.0%), the Mortgage Loan is secured by the related borrowers’ leasehold condominium interests in the first floor retail spaces and an assignment of the related borrowers’ interests in the 11 office floor leasehold condominium units sold to Not-for-Profits, which make up a 340,327 square-foot portion of the building, and the related borrowers’ fee interest of a 21-story, 509,366 square-foot office property.
